paragraphs: Geotab sells fleet management technology that commercial vehicle operators use to track vehicles and run their operations from one system. The company describes what it offers as an open platform for safe, sustainable and cost-effective mobility powered by AI and data intelligence. Video safety is part of the same package, with dash cameras feeding into the MyGeotab software.

The GO tracking device plugs into a vehicle's onboard diagnostics port. Once driving begins it records location, speed, engine idling and distance. Dash cam footage and alert data upload to the cloud so managers can review video later. An analytics layer standardizes data from every vehicle source and enriches it with context such as road conditions, driver history and maintenance records. Developers can extend the platform with sample code and custom add-in pages.

Police and first responders are among the industries the site lists. Geotab reports more than six million connected vehicles. It also claims 26 years of fleet expertise. The company states that the platform is backed by ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications and that its AI aligns with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Support is described as staffed around the clock by experts who are in-market rather than offshored.
